name: Online Co-op
author: Jeffiest
description: Play Dark Cloud (up to four) or Dark Cloud 2 (two) together online. The host plays their own save and opens a room; friends join it from the title screen's Online Co-op with its code and walk into the host's world: the host's story, towns, Georama and dungeons, with their own weapons, items and Gilda. In Dark Cloud a friend's things are kept in the host's save, and a friend's own save is never touched. In Dark Cloud 2 a friend brings one of their own saves instead (past the talk with Donny): its things come along and go back into it, its story is left alone, the host plays Max and the friend Monica, and they can swap; each sees the other's shots, spells, sword trails and Georama parts as they happen, and hears their hero. A dropped friend gets back in by itself; each player's ping is on the HUD. A player knocked out is down, not out: a friend beside them revives them, and a party that all falls walks back to town with its things. Needs the MoonFactory engine with online play (net.*) and visits.

settings.description: A player knocked out lies there instead of the game over; another player beside them holds Revive for three seconds to get them up: R or the right stick in Dark Cloud, V or the left stick in Dark Cloud 2.

settings.name: How often a guest's things are kept, in seconds (Dark Cloud 2: into their own save)
Dark Cloud 2: monsters' life with a friend on the floor
settings.description: While another player stands on the same floor, every monster has this much more life; a monster already out keeps its share. Alone, monsters are as the game has them. The host's choice is the room's.

settings.name: Dark Cloud 2: how much harder monsters hit with a friend on the floor
settings.description: While another player stands on the same floor, monsters' and bosses' blows land this much harder. The host's choice is the room's.

settings.name: Dark Cloud 2: bosses' life with a friend in the fight
settings.description: While another player is in a boss's room, the boss has this much more life. The host's choice is the room's.

settings.name: Dark Cloud 2: more monsters on floors built in a room
settings.description: A floor built while another player is in the room holds this many more of its monsters. The host's choice is the room's; a floor built alone is the game's own.

settings.name: Dark Cloud 2: larger floors built in a room
settings.description: A floor built while another player is in the room has this many more rooms, on ground grown to hold them. The host's choice is the room's; a floor built alone is the game's own.
